'''GXR-7 command droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] it was aboard the [[Thranta-class corvette]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]'' during the [[Attack on the Brentaal Star]] by the [[Gage-class transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]'' and was destroyed by an Imperial boarding party.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
GXR-7 command droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss during the "Black Talon" flashpoint.
